checks.cases: correct fixture passes, injected fault fails, repaired fixture passes

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness has not been measured.
Simultaneous L/E priority is inferred as load priority; original wording does not explicitly state it.
Initial state is unspecified and uninitialized; testbench establishes a known value by loading before comparisons.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation: One one-bit register updated on positive clock edges: L loads R, otherwise E shifts w, otherwise holds Q. Original interface preserved with no reset or extra latency.
static_review: Single sequential driver, nonblocking assignments, one-bit widths, no added reset or initialization; no dependencies beyond TopModule.
